task.title: Cover the board card signature fast path with a test
task.description:
PR #32 (WB-01KZC3PGA0QCXKDQ936VPM67D5) made the board renderer reconcile instead of rebuilding, and the single line internal/webui/assets/index.html:382 (`if (parts.signature === signature) return article;`) is what makes the ticket's acceptance criteria 1 and 2 true: an unchanged task keeps its node and is not written to at all, and a matching signature returns immediately. That line has no test coverage. Verified empirically during review: delete only that line and `go test -count=1 ./internal/webui/` stays fully green, including all six new node-identity tests. Why the existing tests miss it: TestHandlerClientKeepsUnchangedCardNodesAcrossAPoll instruments `ready.insertBefore` and the three `article.remove` methods, but a missing fast path churns each article's *children*, not the column. applyCard() runs `[...article.children].slice(2).forEach((child) => child.remove())` (index.html:393), which destroys and recreates every card's

, .labels and .dependency-progress subtree, and `text(parts.link, task.title)` replaces the title text node — all without touching the column or the article itself. Failure this would let through: on a 69-card board every card's description and label nodes get rebuilt 60 times a minute, so text selected inside a card description is lost every second, and the PR's 'one string comparison and no DOM write' claim silently stops holding. Suggested test: across an unchanged poll, hold a reference to a card's description

(or count remove() calls on the article's children) and assert node identity is preserved. Deferred from PR #32 as a minor review finding: it is missing coverage of already-correct behaviour, not a defect, and the PR is green on both CI jobs.
